instruction: Use the right arm to put the lightweight bell with smooth surface on the handheld electronicscale with smooth finish.

source.instruction: Use the right arm to put the lightweight bell with smooth surface on the handheld electronicscale with smooth finish.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the object, which was at x = +15 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper to (16, -18, 94) and align orientation to grasp bell.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-15, +1, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (16, -18, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right gripper halfway down to z = 88 cm.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -6) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +14 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (16, -18, 88) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Descend to grasp height z = 78 cm and close gripper to grasp the bell.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, -10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (16, -18, 78) opening 0.91; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift bell up to z = 93 cm to clear surrounding objects.

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (15, -18, 93) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper forward to (16, -1, 89) directly over the scale platform.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+1, +16, -4) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (16, -1, 89) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower bell onto scale platform at z = 85 cm and open gripper to release.
